title: Recognize focused Rust-wrapper test commands without requiring bare Cargo or losing host test credit
outcome: A focused run using the maintained scripts/test-rust.sh wrapper through an explicit supported shell can retain temporary-directory containment and still acquire host Test evidence, without treating arbitrary shell scripts as tests or weakening ownership/source/result fences. Document any intentionally unsupported form clearly.
acceptance: Define and independently concur on a bounded allow-list for recognizing the maintained Rust test wrapper inside focused launcher commands, including supported absolute Windows Git shell paths; preserve rejection of arbitrary scripts, build-only flags, compound shell commands and ambiguous placement.

Regression tests demonstrate fail-first then pass for supported wrapper forms and retain fail-closed non-test/unsupported-form controls; passing credit still requires the real launcher result artifact with coherent executed test counts and existing source/ownership/overlap fences.
The exact final input passes the maintained full gate and required independent read-only review pair before landing; documentation agrees with supported focused-wrapper forms.
